title: 地下室换阀门  (Down in the Cellar)

segments.t: Down in the brick cellar beneath the courtyard, Qing hands Chen the new brass valve while shining a bright flashlight onto the silent water heater. Listen first.
老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
一滴水都不漏！现在可以点着热水器了吗？
把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
慢慢拧……听！水冲进来了！
火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
Now let's walk through the repair, line by line.
老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
'Chen, here are both brass valves! Catch my breath? No time!' Quick two-syllable excuse:
没空
literally 'have-no empty-space', means 'I have no free time!'.
手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
'Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.' Look inside
手电筒
built from 'hand' + 'electric' + 'tube', describing a pocket flashlight to perfection.
拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
'Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?' Adding 'off/away' onto 'close' makes
关掉
the everyday way to say 'shut off' a tap, switch, or engine.
关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
'Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.' Polite tool-passing word:
递给
means 'hand over within arm's reach'.
一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
'One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.' Round circular turns or laps take
圈
literally 'circle/ring', counting full twists of the wrench.
把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
'Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.' Repeating 'slow' as 'slow-slow' turns a plain quality into a calm manner phrase before the action: 'slowly twist open'.
摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
'Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!' Adding
起来
after 'warm' marks a new state starting up and rising: 'beginning to warm up'.
三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
'Three minutes to reach the third floor. Fine run today, partner.' Upgrade unlocked:
搭档
means 'partner' or 'teammate'—high praise coming from gruff Chen. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
一滴水都不漏！现在可以点着热水器了吗？
把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
慢慢拧……听！水冲进来了！
火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
A steady blue flame, warming copper pipes, and Chen even called Qing 'partner' instead of 'rookie'. Next time, Hao comes down from the attic for breakfast. See you next time.
回头见！
